#/texts/4.label: paragraph
#/texts/4.full_gt_text:
In exercise of the power conferred by clause (1) of Article 222 of the
Constitution of India, the President, after consultation with the Chief Justice of
India, is pleased to transfer Shri Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh, Chief Justice of
the Tripura High Court, to be Chief Justice of the Telangana High Court and
direct him to assume charge of his office in the Telangana High Court.
